newsitem.title: HUNGARY: FORINT CLOSES DOWN VS DLR AS HUNGARY RATES FALL.
newsitem.headline: FORINT CLOSES DOWN VS DLR AS HUNGARY RATES FALL.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed easier against the dollar on speculation, traders said on Friday.
The forint finished at 151.80/85 against one dollar, down from its opening of 151.68/73.
The Hungarian currency closed some 10 fillers weaker than the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) resistance level (bid).

The forint, which floats in the NBH's 4.5 percent wide intervention band, was pushed to the NBH bid in the past 15 months by demand encouraged by8high domestic interest rates, but recently it often drifted away from the NBH bid.

"The risk that we move away from the edge of the band is increasing because the interest rates are going down," Unicbank's Gabor Liener said. There are one or two banks, who are having strong speculative activity, dealers said.
Discount Treasury bill yields and bank interest rates declined rapidly in the past few weeks.

Mark and yen futures on the Budapest Commodity Exchange closed mostly lower. The mark, the most actively trade unit, accounted for some 1.5 billion forints of the total 3.87 billion forint turnover on Friday.
